points.placeEn: Hapcheon, South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea
points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 全斗焕出生于庆尚南道陕川郡的一个普通农民家庭。他在家乡度过了童年和青少年时期，经历了日本殖民统治和朝鲜战争的影响。这一时期的生活塑造了他强烈的民族主义思想和军事倾向。1949年，他考入韩国陆军士官学校，开始了他的军事生涯。在朝鲜战争期间，他作为一名军官参战，积累了实战经验，并逐渐在军界崭露头角。
points.descriptionEn: Chun Doo-hwan was born in Hapcheon, South Gyeongsang Province, to a farming family. His childhood and adolescence were marked by Japanese colonial rule and the Korean War. These experiences shaped his strong nationalist sentiments and military inclination. In 1949, he entered the Korea Military Academy, beginning his military career. During the Korean War, he served as an officer, gaining combat experience and gradually making a name for himself in the military.

points.title: 军界崛起
points.description: 全斗焕在首尔开始了他的军旅生涯，并在韩国陆军情报部门工作。他凭借敏锐的政治嗅觉和果断的行事风格，在军界迅速晋升。1979年朴正熙遇刺后，他作为保安司令部司令，掌握了军队实权。他与卢泰愚等人组成'新军部'，策划了12·12政变，清除异己，为夺取政权铺平道路。这一时期，他与朴正熙关系密切，深受其影响，形成了自己的政治理念和统治风格。
points.descriptionEn: Chun began his military career in Seoul, working in the Korean Army Intelligence. With his sharp political instincts and decisive actions, he rose rapidly through the military ranks. After Park Chung-hee's assassination in 1979, as head of the Security Command, he gained real military power. He formed the 'New Military Faction' with Roh Tae-woo and others, planning the December 12th Coup to eliminate rivals and pave the way for seizing power. During this period, he maintained close ties with Park Chung-hee, who greatly influenced his political philosophy and ruling style.

points.title: 光州事件
points.description: 1979年12月12日，全斗焕发动军事政变，控制了军队。1980年5月，他下令镇压光州民主化运动，造成大量平民伤亡，史称'光州事件'或'5·18民主化运动'。这一事件成为韩国现代史上最黑暗的一页，也是全斗焕执政期间最大的政治污点。他派遣军队进入光州，实施戒严，使用武力镇压和平示威者，导致数百人死亡，数千人受伤。这一事件深刻影响了韩国的政治发展，成为民主运动的重要转折点。
points.descriptionEn: On December 12, 1979, Chun launched a military coup, taking control of the military. In May 1980, he ordered the suppression of the Gwangju Democratization Movement, resulting in numerous civilian casualties, known as the 'Gwangju Uprising' or 'May 18 Democratization Movement.' This event became one of the darkest chapters in modern Korean history and the biggest political stain of Chun's presidency. He dispatched troops to Gwangju, imposed martial law, and used force to suppress peaceful demonstrators, leading to hundreds of deaths and thousands of injuries. This event profoundly influenced Korean political development, becoming a crucial turning point for the democracy movement.

points.title: 总统任期
points.description: 1980年，全斗焕通过'国家保卫非常对策委员会'掌握政权，1981年正式当选为韩国第11届总统。他推行'新秩序'政策，加强中央集权，压制政治反对派。在经济方面，他继续推行出口导向型工业化政策，使韩国经济持续增长，成功举办1986年亚运会和1988年奥运会。然而，他的独裁统治和光州事件的阴影始终存在。1987年，面对全国范围内的民主化示威，他被迫接受'6·29宣言'，同意直接选举总统，标志着韩国民主化进程的重要一步。1988年，他卸任总统，但仍然保持政治影响力。
points.descriptionEn: In 1980, Chun seized power through the 'National Security Emergency Policy Committee' and was officially elected as South Korea's 11th president in 1981. He implemented the 'New Order' policy, strengthening central authority and suppressing political opposition. Economically, he continued the export-oriented industrialization policies, leading to sustained economic growth and successfully hosting the 1986 Asian Games and 1988 Olympics. However, his authoritarian rule and the shadow of the Gwangju Incident persisted. In 1987, facing nationwide democratization protests, he was forced to accept the 'June 29 Declaration,' agreeing to direct presidential elections, marking a significant step in South Korea's democratization process. He stepped down as president in 1988 but remained politically influential.

points.title: 下台与审判
points.description: 1988年韩国实现民主化后，全斗焕的政治影响力逐渐减弱。1995年，他因涉嫌参与12·12政变和光州事件被起诉。1996年，他因叛乱、贪污受贿等罪名被判处死刑，后减为无期徒刑。1997年，在金泳三总统特赦下获释。这一审判过程标志着韩国民主制度对威权统治的清算，也是韩国民主化进程的重要里程碑。全斗焕的下台和审判反映了韩国社会对民主和人权的追求，以及对过去威权统治的反思。
points.descriptionEn: After South Korea's democratization in 1988, Chun's political influence gradually waned. In 1995, he was indicted for his involvement in the December 12th Coup and the Gwangju Incident. In 1996, he was sentenced to death for rebellion, corruption, and other charges, later commuted to life imprisonment. In 1997, he was pardoned under President Kim Young-sam's special amnesty. This trial marked the democratic system's reckoning with authoritarian rule and became an important milestone in South Korea's democratization process. Chun's fall and trial reflected South Korean society's pursuit of democracy and human rights, as well as its reflection on past authoritarian rule.

points.title: 晚年生活
points.description: 获释后，全斗焕逐渐淡出政坛，过着低调的私人生活。他偶尔发表一些政治评论，但已不再具有实质性影响力。2013年，他因涉嫌在总统任期内收受贿赂被判处150亿韩元罚款。2020年，他因涉嫌在光州事件中的责任被再次调查。2021年，他因健康原因被法院推迟审判。全斗焕的晚年生活反映了韩国社会对威权统治的复杂态度，既有对历史责任的追究，也有对时代背景的理解。他的去世将标志着一个时代的结束，也是韩国现代史研究的重要节点。
points.descriptionEn: After his release, Chun gradually withdrew from politics, living a private, low-profile life. Occasionally, he made political comments but no longer held substantive influence. In 2013, he was fined 15 billion won for suspected bribery during his presidency. In 2020, he was investigated again regarding his responsibility in the Gwangju Incident. In 2021, his trial was postponed due to health reasons. Chun's later years reflect the complex attitudes of South Korean society toward authoritarian rule, involving both accountability for historical responsibilities and understanding of the historical context. His death would mark the end of an era and an important point of reference in the study of modern Korean history.

appraisal.zh: 全斗焕在韩国史学界被视为由军事威权走向民主转型的关键人物，其统治既是军事威权的高峰，也是其终结的开端，光州事件成为民主运动的象征，他的下台与审判则标志民主制度的成熟，流行文化中他常被呈现为兼具经济成就与压制民主污点的复杂形象。然而压倒性的判断是，他靠军事政变夺权，对光州事件的镇压造成大量平民伤亡，压制政治自由、侵犯人权并有腐败问题，是韩国民主史上的黑暗一页，其政治遗产至今仍有负面影响。
appraisal.en: Chun Doo-hwan is seen by historians as a pivotal figure in South Korea's move from military authoritarianism toward democracy: his rule marked both the zenith of authoritarianism and the beginning of its end, the Gwangju Uprising became a symbol of the democracy movement, and his downfall and trial signaled the maturing of democratic institutions; popular culture often portrays him as a complex figure combining economic achievement with the stain of suppressing democracy. The overwhelming judgment, however, is that he seized power through a military coup, that the suppression of Gwangju caused numerous civilian casualties, and that his suppression of political freedom, human rights violations and corruption make his rule a dark chapter whose legacy still weighs on South Korean society.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为全斗焕是韩国经济现代化的关键推动者，他在任期间成功举办了亚运会和奥运会，提升了韩国的国际地位。他们强调他维持了政治稳定，为韩国经济腾飞创造了条件，并推动了汉江奇迹的实现。支持者还指出，他在后期推动了民主化进程，为韩国的政治转型奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Supporters view Chun Doo-hwan as a key driver of South Korea's economic modernization. They highlight his successful hosting of the Asian Games and Olympics, which elevated South Korea's international standing. Emphasizing his maintenance of political stability, they argue he created conditions for South Korea's economic takeoff and the realization of the Han River Miracle. Supporters also note his role in promoting democratization in later years, laying the foundation for South Korea's political transformation.

critic.zh: 批评者谴责全斗焕是独裁者和军事政变的策划者，特别是对光州事件的镇压造成大量平民伤亡，成为韩国民主进程的严重挫折。他们批评他通过不正当手段获取权力，压制政治自由，侵犯人权，以及任内的腐败问题。批评者认为他的统治是韩国民主发展史上的黑暗时期，其政治遗产至今仍对韩国社会产生负面影响。
critic.en: Critics denounce Chun Doo-hwan as a dictator and mastermind of a military coup, particularly condemning the suppression of the Gwangju Uprising that resulted in numerous civilian casualties, representing a severe setback for South Korea's democratization. They criticize his acquisition of power through illegitimate means, suppression of political freedoms, human rights violations, and corruption during his tenure. Critics view his rule as a dark period in South Korea's democratic development, arguing his political legacy continues to negatively impact South Korean society.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，全斗焕是韩国从威权统治向民主转型过程中的关键人物。他的统治代表了韩国军事威权统治的顶峰，也是其终结的开始。光州事件成为韩国民主运动的象征，而他的下台和审判则标志着韩国民主制度的成熟。在流行文化中，全斗焕常被描绘为韩国现代史上的复杂人物，既有推动经济发展的成就，也有压制民主的污点，反映了韩国社会对自身历史的复杂态度。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Chun Doo-hwan represents a pivotal figure in South Korea's transition from authoritarian rule to democracy. His administration marked the zenith of military authoritarian rule in South Korea while also signaling its beginning. The Gwangju Incident has become a symbol of South Korea's democracy movement, while his downfall and trial marked the maturation of South Korea's democratic system. In popular culture, Chun is often portrayed as a complex figure in modern Korean history, credited with economic achievements while also bearing the stain of suppressing democracy, reflecting South Korean society's complex attitude toward its own history.

self.zh: 我将以我的生命和鲜血来保卫国家。
self.en: I will defend the nation with my life and blood.
